title: Jawahar Mal Musters a Broad Anti-Abdali Coalition

blocks.text: As Abdali reaches Ambala and prepares to threaten the Jat ruler, Jawahar Mal refuses to wait passively. Calling an assembly of Rajputs, Marathas and Brars, together with Gosains, hill chiefs, and other allies, he turns the conflict into a wider regional challenge to Afghan power.

The page pairs this coalition-building with military readiness. Reaching Ambala, Abdali pushes forward, but on the other side the war-drum did he order to be beaten as Jawahar Mal resolves that on the Gilja Pathan forces would he launch an attack before fear can dissolve the alliance.

This display of organization deeply unsettles Rohilla calculations. Once Khalsa support, money, and war plans become visible, this Abdali's puppet came to the end of his wits and can no longer assume that the Jat ruler will be isolated or easily coerced.
